title: Project-one initial monitoring protected policy
description: Local protected JSON selected only by PROJECT_ONE_MONITORING_CONFIG_FILE. Omitted optional fields use monitoring.Defaults. Unknown/duplicate/wrong types fail. No secret or provider URL field. Parent owns Compose/Helm mount and global typed boundary. Same target binary, restart to apply.

format_version.description: Monitoring configuration schema version; fixed protocol, not a feature switch.

operation_seconds.description: Owning selected snapshot transaction deadline in seconds, including current authority, license, owner reads and audit. Restart required.

lookback_seconds.description: Server DB-clock gateway admission lookback in seconds. No client override. Restart required.

maximum_gateway_rows.description: Maximum retained gateway rows/latency values per snapshot; one extra existence row marks truncation. Not total-window coverage. Restart required.

node_page_size.description: Maximum current scoped node observations per canonical keyset page. Restart required.

concurrent_snapshots.description: Per-control-process snapshot admission slots; saturation fails MONITORING_BUSY without an unbounded queue. Restart required.

latency_milliseconds.description: Strictly increasing finite inclusive histogram upper bounds in milliseconds; runtime also validates order. Counts are exclusive per bin, not cumulative Prometheus exposition. Final bucket is overflow. Restart resets epoch/counters.

structured_logging.description: Enable bounded fixed-field redacted slog events; false disables events without disabling metrics/auth. Inject original structured logger. Restart required.

maximum_logs_per_second.description: Maximum events per actual process time interval; skipped count is explicit. Valid even when logging false. No outbound alert sink. Restart required.
